title: Explain How to Send a Gift

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend explaining how you would prepare and send a small gift. Describe the gift, its recipient, the packaging, the information you would check, and one choice about delivery. Use at least six lesson words and two sentences with who, which, that or where.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: the person and gift; safe packaging; the address or code you check; the delivery choice and a final message. Explain your own decisions.

reference: I would send a small handmade cup to my cousin, who lives in another city. First, I would write a short letter about the person who made the cup. The cup is fragile, so I would wrap it in paper and put it in a cardboard box. I would fill the empty space and seal the top with tape. Before I post the parcel, I would confirm the recipient's address and zip code in a message. The office where I plan to send it can explain the fee and delivery choices. I would choose an option that gives me proof of payment. Afterward, I would tell my cousin when the parcel may arrive. I would keep the slip until she says she has received the gift.
